prose: Axios reports that Databricks acquired spreadsheet startup Row Zero to expand the capabilities of its AI coworker Genie. Row Zero had raised a $10M seed round led by IA Ventures. The article is paywalled, so this summary is based on the headline and lead captured by the feed.
highlights: Databricks acquires spreadsheet startup Row Zero
Goal: expand its AI coworker Genie
Row Zero had raised a $10M seed led by IA Ventures
Paywalled - summary based on headline and lead
